baseHeader.methodology: Source-linked original summaries and reference-guided educational reconstructions. Models and motion are unvalidated; artist titles do not independently verify taxonomy. Navigation groups are not a universal kingdom system. Microbial behavior depends on strain and conditions. Expansion entries are individually referenced authored morphology studies; legacy Protista/Monera reporting categories do not replace modern domains. Actual screenshots, software checks and draft status are distinct from independent scientific validation.

visual.fidelity: Species-specific authored reference reconstruction; partly stylized and unmeasured
visual.description: Distinct elongated curved outline, narrow paired valves, muted brown/purple numerical surface marks and smoother periostracal response. End gapes, united siphons, foot and vertical sediment support are not reconstructed. This exposed shell presentation is not the living buried feeding posture. Original authored reconstruction, partly stylized and unmeasured; no independent biological validation.

review.status: Individual visual review recorded; draft reconstruction; independent biological validation pending
review.remainingInaccuracies: Outline remains too lens-like and flattened; the living shell is a long partly open tube with distinct ends. Hinge, shell thickness, foot and siphons are missing. Beach shell is not burrowing-posture evidence; filtration unavailable.
